responseSets.title: rewrite request
responses: {opener} I can rewrite this in a {slot:style} voice while keeping the original meaning intact.
{acknowledgement} I will keep the useful parts, smooth the wording, and make it easier to read.
{opener} I can give you a cleaner version and keep the tone consistent with the rest of the chat.

responseSets.title: code or file task
responses: {opener} I will treat this as a file task, preserve the working parts, and only change what is needed.
{acknowledgement} The useful response should be specific: what changed, what stayed intact, and where the finished files are.
{opener} I will keep the output structured so it can be dropped into a static chatbot project.

responseSets.title: repetition control
responses: The response can keep the same meaning while rotating openers, sentence shape, and closing lines.
A useful reply bank should vary wording without changing the bot’s personality or intent.
This should reduce exact repeats by choosing from local candidates and remembering recent output.
